summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing audited financial results for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, along with operational highlights and management commentary. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or other special situation. It is a routine earnings release. A CFO transition is noted as effective January 1, 2026, but this is a planned succession without abrupt departure or board contest. Conservative classification: no special-situation category applies.
